items.reason: Verifier runs write timestamped documents under the set’s verify directory.
Collision handling retains separate reports, and writing occurs once after agent fallback completes.
The verdict-first contract remains; reply prose becomes the report body.
Existing verdict parsing remains unchanged, and malformed replies retain their raw text.
Report writing applies to PASS, FIXABLE, and NEEDS-HUMAN.
The response contract requires PASS findings explaining checks and each criterion’s satisfaction.
Cache hits return before report creation.
Invalidation deletes cached verdicts without touching report files.
Previous reports never enter Verifier prompts; human-note forwarding remains intact.
Human acceptance writes a report without invoking an agent.
Human reports include the rationale and overridden verdict.
The header identifies human authorship as “human (Accept).”
Human reports use the same writer, header structure, directory, and latest-report lookup.
The gate displays the latest report’s path and recorded commit without its body.
A conditional menu entry pages the report and returns to the gate.
The task-set detail view renders the Verify report pointer.
Verify artifacts rank above Refine artifacts.
Agent prompt views gain no pointer; only Verifier response-contract goldens change.
Absent reports produce no Verify preamble, paging entry, detail pointer, or artifact.
Verified-at and status derivation remain independent of report age.
Status rows retain truncated findings but gain no adjacent report pointer; the pointer appears only in the detail view.
Both passes share rendering, filing, timestamp scanning, and document-header parsing.
Refine retains its existing filenames, directory, headers, and rendering through shared machinery.
Refine prompt golden files are unchanged.

scores.rationale: Clear shared implementation with focused regression coverage; the required status-row pointer is missing. Assessment was static against the parent tree and supplied diff.
